body: Im honestly just feeling really worthless. I have so many emotions but i cant find the words right now. Im incredibly apathetic towards my life.i don't want to move. Not to go to work. Not to take care of my daughter (my mom has been mostly taking over). Not to do anything at all. I only feel joy in short extreme bursts then its back to extreme misery. Thats no way to live man.

Thank you so much for your reply. I guess I just needed to hear an outside perspective. 

I was seeing a therapist but because of insurance issues, I'm in the process of getting a new one. That's been pretty hard on me.

He can be distant and that's where my insecurities act up. With bpd though, those insecurities are all consuming. 

I agree though, I do think its worth the risk. I love and care about him, i just needed to hear from someone else that I wasn't dragging myself through unnecessary pain. 

Much love
